title: Cousin Wilfred Pratt, banjoist with Kelly, Celestin, Kid Rena and Robichaux
summary: Joseph's cousin Wilfred Pratt played banjo with Chris Kelly, Papa Celestin, Kid Rena and Robichaux; a photo is shown and his death by shooting is mentioned.
